source_solver: gurobipy 13.0.3 (Gurobi 13.0.3, size-limited pip licence); original notebook technician_routing_scheduling.ipynb code cells run via exec on 2026-11-02 (only the %pip line dropped, the raw.githubusercontent.com workbook URLs pointed at local copies of the same data-Sce0.xlsx / data-Sce3.xlsx, and a line recording ObjVal/NumVars/NumConstrs/NumIntVars inserted before m.dispose())
notes: Scenario 1 solve of the notebook (workbook data-Sce3.xlsx: capacities 240/180 min); the base solve on data-Sce0.xlsx has objective 0 and is not used. Gurobi reports NumVars 660 (49 assign + 7 use + 567 route + 9 start time + 7 lateness + 7 early-start + 7 late-start + 7 unfilled), NumConstrs 217, NumIntVars 630 (all binary), MIP gap 0. Optimum 12410 = Customer4 (Equipment Installation, priority 2) left unfilled (2 * 6100) + Customer5 finishing 105 min late (2 * 105). Over the optimal face (min/max with the objective fixed) unfilled, window and lateness penalties, jobs unfilled (1, always Customer4) and lateness minutes (105) are unique; technicians used (3-7) and travel minutes (402-808) are not, so they are not scoring KPIs. Same formulation and size (no reformulation); PuLP drops zero coefficients from lpSum, so the capacity rows are built as explicit term lists to keep the 14 zero-length depot self-loop arcs (only present in those rows) as in Gurobi. Notebook values hard-coded there are params here: t upper bound 600 and big-M base (day_length_min), M = 6100 (unfilled_job_penalty), 0.01 * M (window_violation_penalty = 61), weight 1 on priority-weighted lateness (lateness_penalty). Notebook quirks reproduced as computed: Customer5 in data-Sce3.xlsx has due time 0 (window 0-600), so it is always at least its 60-min duration late; only qualified technicians count toward covering a job, but the at-most-one-technician row sums over all technicians, so an unfilled job may still be visited by an unqualified technician at no penalty change; service start times are per location (customers must not share a location); t is also defined at depots and is free in [0, 600]; sequencing rows include a customer with itself, which forbids self-loop arcs at customer locations; depot self-loop arcs and depot-to-depot arcs exist (the latter fixed to 0) but have no effect. HiGHS, SCIP and CBC reach 12410 in under 0.2 s.
